notes: This is the P3-A6 axis under test. Floor surface override is alpha_feather=12 (vs P3-A5's 8). The expectation was that looser feather would re-introduce halo — and it does, partially. Across all motion strips, the Red Bull patch sits on a faintly visible bluer/cooler rectangle that does not match the surrounding court paint exactly: the feathered alpha falloff zone is wider than P3-A5's, so its luminance/hue mismatch with the matte court is now visible at the patch perimeter for ~10-12 px around the wordmark. This is the canonical halo case the rubric v2 calls out. It is not severe — the original MELBOURNE letters are not bleeding through (post_blend_cleanup is doing its job) — but the bluer-rectangle halo scores 3 on halo_presence vs P3-A5's clean 5. Edge_reflex on letters is fine (4) — the looser feather softens edges gently rather than smearing. Net: looser feather=12 noticeably regressed halo_presence as predicted.
